text:
maya: CI turned red on my deps bump PR (poetry lock regenerated). failing in integ tests. pinging in case anyone is awake :wave:

ci-bot: build #4821 failed — pytest -k 'integration' — 1 failed, 3 passed. See logs: https://ci.internal/4821

maya: quick log snippet:

```
E   ImportError: cannot import name 'parse_authority' from 'rfc3986' (/opt/venv/lib/python3.9/site-packages/rfc3986/__init__.py)

tests/integration/test_routing.py:42: ImportError
```

sahil: what did you bump? full diff of poetry.lock?

maya: bumped rfc3986 1.5.0 -> 2.0.0 (transitive via httpx upgrade). lockfile updated by `poetry lock --no-update` after CI repro.

ryan: hmm rfc3986 2.0 removed some public API — parse_authority moved/renamed. Tests import it indirectly from our util shim.

jess: can you paste the failing import stack?

maya: stack shows our utils/uri.py: `from rfc3986 import parse_authority` then propagated to routing code. The shim used internal API.

sahil: ok that explains. Two options: pin rfc3986 to <2.0 or update our shim to use new API. For quick unblocking, pin is faster.

ryan: agree. but where did the transitive come from? which package required httpx?

maya: httpx 0.24.0 depends on rfc3986 >=1.4.0; 0.25.0 bumped rfc3986 to ^2.0.0. Our direct deps had httpx bumped in the same PR (to 0.25.0).

jess: can we run a local repro matrix? maya, can you run in a fresh venv with the previous lock vs new lock?

maya: running now. commands I used:

```
python -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate
pip install poetry
poetry install --no-dev
pytest tests/integration/test_routing.py -q
```

ci-bot: maya triggered rerun for build #4821 (replay).

maya: confirmed: with lockfile pinned to rfc3986==1.5.0 tests pass locally. With rfc3986==2.0.1 they fail.

sahil: ok let's do an emergency lockfile patch: add a constraint in pyproject or constraints.txt to keep rfc3986 <2.0. I'll open a quick PR to revert the httpx bump if easier.

ryan: prefer to fix our shim in parallel — will be more future-proof. maya can you file a tiny issue and assign to me? I'll PR the shim change plus add a compatibility test for both versions if feasible.

maya: filed issue #3421 and assigned to ryan. PR coming for re-pin: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/7890 — pin rfc3986<2.0 in poetry.lock, CI rerun after that should be green.

jess: thanks. can we also add a note in the dependency bump checklist to run `python -c "import rfc3986; print(rfc3986.__version__)"` or run our compatibility script?

sahil: great idea. I can add a CI job that warns when a transitive rfc3986>=2.0 appears. quick guard until we update codebase.

maya: reran CI after the lock pin PR — build #4823 is queued.

ci-bot: build #4823 succeeded — all integration tests passed. :tada:

ryan: I'll work on the shim patch next week. leaving a TODO to remove the pin after we support rfc3986 v2.

maya: thanks everyone, unblocking customers. :thumbsup:

jess: follow-up - can we list which other libs might transitively pull rfc3986? sahil, maybe add to the dependency docs.

sahil: will do, adding rfc3986 to watchlist and updating the bump playbook.

maya: closing the loop here. If anything else pops up ping me.
